title: Photograph

cues.en: Love in can hurt, Love in can hurt sometimes
cues.zh: 愛會受傷，愛有時也會受傷
cues.text: Love in can hurt, Love in can hurt sometimes

cues.en: But it's the only thing that I know
cues.zh: 但這是我唯一知道的
cues.text: But it's the only thing that I know

cues.en: When it gets hard, You know it can get hard sometimes
cues.zh: 當事情變得困難時，你知道有時會變得困難
cues.text: When it gets hard, You know it can get hard sometimes

cues.en: It is the only thing that makes us feel alive
cues.zh: 這是唯一讓我們感到活著的東西
cues.text: It is the only thing that makes us feel alive

cues.en: We keep this love in a photograph
cues.zh: 我們將這份愛儲存在照片中
cues.text: We keep this love in a photograph

cues.en: We make these memories for ourselves
cues.zh: 我們為自己創造這些回憶
cues.text: We make these memories for ourselves

cues.en: Where our eyes are never closing, hearts are never broken
cues.zh: 我們的眼睛永遠不會閉上，心永遠不會破碎
cues.text: Where our eyes are never closing, hearts are never broken

cues.en: Times forever frozen still
cues.zh: 時光永遠凍結
cues.text: Times forever frozen still

cues.en: So you can keep me inside the pocket of your ripped jeans
cues.zh: 這樣你就可以把我放在你破洞牛仔褲的口袋裡
cues.text: So you can keep me inside the pocket of your ripped jeans

cues.en: Holding me closer till eyes meet
cues.zh: 把我抱得更近直到目光相遇
cues.text: Holding me closer till eyes meet

cues.en: You won't ever be alone
cues.zh: 你永遠不會孤單
cues.text: You won't ever be alone

cues.en: Wait for me to come home
cues.zh: 等我回家
cues.text: Wait for me to come home

cues.en: Love in can heal, Love in can mend your soul
cues.zh: 愛可以治癒，愛可以治癒你的靈魂
cues.text: Love in can heal, Love in can mend your soul

cues.en: I swear it will get easier, Remember that whatever it pays for you
cues.zh: 我發誓它會變得更容易，記住，無論它為你付出什麼
cues.text: I swear it will get easier, Remember that whatever it pays for you

cues.en: And it's the only thing we take with us when we die
cues.zh: 這是我們死後唯一能帶走的東西
cues.text: And it's the only thing we take with us when we die

cues.en: We keep this love in a photograph
cues.zh: 我們將這份愛儲存在照片中
cues.text: We keep this love in a photograph

cues.zh: 時光永遠凍結

cues.text: So you can keep me inside the pocket of your ripped jeans

cues.en: Holding me closer till eyes meet
cues.zh: 把我抱得更近直到目光相遇
cues.text: Holding me closer till eyes meet

cues.en: You won't ever be alone
cues.zh: 你永遠不會孤單
cues.text: You won't ever be alone

cues.en: It won't you hurt me
cues.zh: 你不會傷害我
cues.text: It won't you hurt me

cues.en: That's okay baby, only once we bleed
cues.zh: 沒關係寶貝，只要我們流血一次
cues.text: That's okay baby, only once we bleed

cues.en: Inside these pages you just hold me
cues.zh: 在這些頁面裡你只是抱著我
cues.text: Inside these pages you just hold me

cues.en: I won't ever let you go
cues.zh: 我永遠不會讓你走
cues.text: I won't ever let you go

cues.en: Wait for me to come home
cues.zh: 等我回家
cues.text: Wait for me to come home

cues.en: Love for me to come home
cues.zh: 愛我回家
cues.text: Love for me to come home

cues.en: Love in can feed me inside the necklace
cues.zh: 項鍊裡的愛可以餵飽我
cues.text: Love in can feed me inside the necklace

cues.en: You go up when you're a sixteenth
cues.zh: 當你十六歲的時候你就上去了
cues.text: You go up when you're a sixteenth

cues.en: Next to your heartbeat that I should be
cues.zh: 我應該在你的心跳旁邊
cues.text: Next to your heartbeat that I should be

cues.en: Keep it deep within your soul
cues.zh: 將它留在你的靈魂深處
cues.text: Keep it deep within your soul

cues.en: And if you hurt me
cues.zh: 如果你傷害了我
cues.text: And if you hurt me

cues.en: Well that's okay baby, only once we bleed
cues.zh: 好吧，寶貝，只要我們流血一次
cues.text: Well that's okay baby, only once we bleed

cues.en: Inside these pages you just hold me
cues.zh: 在這些頁面裡你只是抱著我
cues.text: Inside these pages you just hold me

cues.en: I won't ever let you go
cues.zh: 我永遠不會讓你走
cues.text: I won't ever let you go

cues.en: I won't be alone
cues.zh: 我不會孤單
cues.text: I won't be alone

cues.en: I will remember how you kissed me
cues.zh: 我會記得你是如何吻我的
cues.text: I will remember how you kissed me

cues.en: Under the lamppost back on Sixth Street
cues.zh: 第六街燈柱下
cues.text: Under the lamppost back on Sixth Street

cues.en: Hearing you whisper through the phone
cues.zh: 透過電話聽到你的竊竊私語
cues.text: Hearing you whisper through the phone

cues.en: Wait for me to come home
cues.zh: 等我回家
cues.text: Wait for me to come home
